editions.title: The Inca Trail Is No Joke 🥵
editions.excerpt: Steep climbs, breathtaking views and one very tired traveler. Here's what hiking through the Peruvian Andes really looks like! 🇵🇪

editions.title: The Road to Machu Picchu Begins! 🏔️
editions.excerpt: On Today November 11 , I'm taking on the legendary 2-day Short Inca Trail to Machu Picchu ! 🥾 Around 12 km of ancient stone paths, mountain scenery and Inca ruins, with the incredible Sun Gate along the way.

editions.title: Ancient Ruins, Wild Nights & a Budget Reality Check 🇵🇪
editions.excerpt: Three days in Lima, from a chaotic airport arrival and ancient ruins to unforgettable nights out in Miraflores. And one thing I quickly discovered? Peru isn't always as cheap as you might expect.
